rationale: At the 7.02 ns floor every AREA 3 run is limited at ss 100C max-RC by a port path at 6.30-6.36 ns, ~0.3 ns better than the 6.62 ns repair aim; reg-to-reg sits at 6.07-6.36 with repair idle. Target and margins are maxed. Hold (0 buffers), slew/cap (0 vs 309) and DRC are not binding, so netlist and geometry are the remaining levers. Reg-to-reg was fastest at high local cell density (util 42, density 54); the port path did best on larger dies (util 36 best, 42/46 worse). A: best run with ABC buffering off (sizing kept), leaving fanout buffering to placement-aware repair. B: util 30 with density 50: bigger die, compact core.
